questions.stem: 在被要求將文物歸還原屬國時，許多博物館發現，拖得越久，受到的批評就越強烈。
questions.answer: When asked to return cultural objects to their home countries, many museums find that the longer they delay, the fiercer the criticism becomes.
accepted_answers: When asked to return artifacts to their countries of origin, many museums have found that the longer they wait, the stronger the criticism grows.
When asked to give cultural relics back to their countries of origin, many museums realize that the longer they put it off, the harsher the criticism they receive.

patterns: 愈…愈…（拖得越久，批評越強烈）
連接詞＋過去分詞（When asked to …）

questions.stem: 在這場爭議中，最根本的問題不是這些文物值多少錢，而是它們真正屬於哪裡。
questions.answer: In this dispute, the most fundamental issue is not how much these objects are worth but where they truly belong.
accepted_answers: In this debate, the most basic question is not how valuable these cultural artifacts are, but where they really belong.
In this controversy, the most fundamental question is not what these cultural relics are worth but where they actually belong.

patterns: 間接問句（值多少錢／屬於哪裡：how much … / where …）
最高級（最根本的問題：the most fundamental issue）

1.explanation_zh: 「在被要求…時」博物館是被要求的一方，用「連接詞＋過去分詞」When asked to …，等於 When they are asked to …；省略的主詞必須和主要子句的主詞（many museums）相同。「文物」可寫 cultural objects、artifacts 或 cultural relics；「原屬國」是 home countries／countries of origin。「許多博物館發現」用現在式 find 或現在完成式 have found 都可以。「拖得越久，批評就越強烈」用 the longer they delay, the fiercer the criticism becomes，兩個子句都以 the＋比較級開頭，「批評」用名詞 criticism。
evidence: 在被要求將文物歸還原屬國時
拖得越久，受到的批評就越強烈
1.strategy_zh: 先寫主幹 many museums find that …，that 子句裡放「越…越…」；句首的時間子句簡化成 When asked to …。
hints: 切成四段：在被要求將文物歸還原屬國時／許多博物館發現／拖得越久／受到的批評就越強烈
標的詞彙：return（歸還）、object（文物：cultural objects／artifacts）、museum（博物館）、criticism（批評）、fierce（強烈的）
句型框架：When asked to VR …, S + find that the + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V

2.explanation_zh: 「最根本的問題」用最高級 the most fundamental issue（或 the most basic question），「問題」指要討論的議題，用 issue／question 最貼切。「不是…而是…」用 not A but B，A、B 都是間接問句：how much these objects are worth（值多少錢用 be worth）、where they truly belong，語序都是直述句。「文物」可寫 objects、artifacts 或 cultural relics。
evidence: 不是這些文物值多少錢，而是它們真正屬於哪裡
2.strategy_zh: 主幹是 the most fundamental issue is not A but B；A、B 各自寫成 wh- 名詞子句，注意不要用疑問句語序。
hints: 切成四段：在這場爭議中／最根本的問題／不是這些文物值多少錢／而是它們真正屬於哪裡
標的詞彙：dispute（爭議）、fundamental（根本的）、issue（議題）、worth（值…錢）、belong（屬於）
句型框架：the most + adj. + N + is not how much + S + be worth but where + S + V

references: When asked to return cultural objects to their home countries, many museums find that the longer they delay, the fiercer the criticism becomes.
When asked to return artifacts to their countries of origin, many museums have found that the longer they wait, the stronger the criticism grows.
When asked to give cultural relics back to their countries of origin, many museums realize that the longer they put it off, the harsher the criticism they receive.

common_errors.right: When asked to return cultural objects to their home countries
common_errors.explanation_zh: 博物館是「被要求」的一方，要用過去分詞 asked；asking 是主動「要求別人」。

common_errors.wrong: When asked to returning cultural objects to their home countries
common_errors.right: When asked to return cultural objects to their home countries
common_errors.explanation_zh: ask sb to VR 的 to 是不定詞，後面接原形動詞 return。
主詞 museums 是複數，動詞不加 s。

accepted: the longer they put it off
the longer they hold on to them

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「越…越…」兩個子句都要以 the＋比較級開頭。

accepted: the harsher the criticism they receive
the stronger the criticism they receive
the fiercer the criticism they face
the more intense the criticism becomes
the more severe the criticism they receive
the more harshly they are criticized

common_errors.wrong: the more strong the criticism becomes

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「批評」在這裡是名詞 criticism；get criticize 同時錯在詞性和被動（要寫 get criticized）。

traps.explanation_zh: 「受到的批評」是抽象名詞 criticism，寫成 the fiercer the criticism becomes；把「受到批評」直接翻成 get criticize 會同時錯在詞性與被動。

traps.literal_error: When asking to return cultural objects to their home countries, many museums find that the longer they delay, the fiercer the criticism becomes.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文有「被」：博物館是被要求的一方，要用過去分詞 When asked to …；寫成 When asking 意思變成博物館去要求別人。

bonus.text: When asked to return artifacts to their countries of origin, many museums learn that every year of delay only invites fiercer criticism.
bonus.explanation_zh: 把「拖得越久，批評越強烈」改寫成 every year of delay only invites fiercer criticism（每拖一年只會招來更強烈的批評），用抽象名詞當主詞，句子更精簡。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在被要求…時」省略主詞與 be 動詞，寫成 When asked to …（省略的主詞要和主要子句的 many museums 相同）；「受到的批評就越強烈」以「批評」為主詞，寫成 the fiercer the criticism becomes，比較級要移到子句開頭。

references: In this dispute, the most fundamental issue is not how much these objects are worth but where they truly belong.
In this debate, the most basic question is not how valuable these cultural artifacts are, but where they really belong.
In this controversy, the most fundamental question is not what these cultural relics are worth but where they actually belong.

patterns.label_zh: 最高級（最根本的問題：the most fundamental issue）

common_errors.explanation_zh: 介系詞 in 後面接名詞 dispute／debate；argue 是動詞。

common_errors.right: the most fundamental issue is not

common_errors.explanation_zh: 多音節形容詞的最高級用 the most，不加 -est。

parts.zh: 不是這些文物值多少錢
accepted: is not how much these objects are worth
is not how valuable these cultural artifacts are
is not how valuable these artifacts are
is not what these cultural relics are worth
is not how much these artifacts are worth
is not how much these cultural relics are worth

common_errors.wrong: is not how much money these objects value
common_errors.right: is not how much these objects are worth
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「值多少錢」用 be worth：how much they are worth；value 當動詞是「重視、估價」。

common_errors.wrong: is not how much are these objects worth
common_errors.right: is not how much these objects are worth
common_errors.explanation_zh: 名詞子句用直述句語序：how much＋主詞＋be worth。

parts.zh: 而是它們真正屬於哪裡

common_errors.wrong: but where do they truly belong
common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句不用疑問句語序（不加 do）。
主詞 they 是複數，動詞不加 s。

traps.explanation_zh: 「爭議」在這裡是名詞，介系詞 in 後面要接名詞 dispute／debate／controversy；argue 是動詞。

traps.literal_error: is not how much money these objects value
traps.explanation_zh: 「值多少錢」英文用 be worth：how much these objects are worth；直譯成 how much money … value 是錯誤搭配。

bonus.text: What matters most in this dispute is not how much these objects are worth but where they truly belong.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 What matters most … is …（準分裂句）強調「最重要的是」，是作文也常用的加分句型。

2.restructuring_zh: 「不是…而是…」用 not A but B，A、B 都改寫成間接問句（名詞子句）：how much these objects are worth、where they truly belong，語序都是直述句；「值多少錢」不要逐字翻，用 be worth。

1.translation: When asked to return artifacts to their countries of origin, many museums have found that the longer they delay, the stronger the criticism they receive.
1.explanation_zh: 「在被要求…時」用省略主詞與 be 動詞的副詞子句 When asked to ...（完整是 When they are asked to）；「原屬國」譯 countries of origin；「發現」接 that 子句，用現在完成式表示到目前為止的經驗；「拖得越久，受到的批評就越強烈」用 the longer ..., the stronger ... 比較級句型。

2.translation: In this controversy, the most fundamental question is not how much these artifacts are worth but where they truly belong.
2.explanation_zh: 「不是…而是…」用 not A but B，A、B 都是名詞子句（how much ... are worth／where they truly belong），結構對稱；「最根本的問題」用最高級 the most fundamental question；「爭議」譯 controversy（也可用 dispute）。

1.translation: When asked to return cultural relics to their countries of origin, many museums find that the longer they delay, the stronger the criticism they receive.
1.explanation_zh: 「在被要求……時」用省略的被動分詞子句 When asked to ...；「歸還原屬國」用 return ... to their countries of origin；「拖得越久，批評就越強烈」用 the longer ..., the stronger ... 比較級對應結構，並用 find that 引導名詞子句。「文物」可譯 cultural relics 或 artifacts，兩者皆可；時態用現在式表一般現象，也可用現在完成式 have found。

2.translation: In this controversy, the most fundamental question is not how much these artifacts are worth, but where they truly belong.
2.explanation_zh: 「不是……而是……」用 not ... but ...；兩個名詞子句 how much these artifacts are worth 與 where they truly belong 平行；「最根本的問題」用最高級 the most fundamental question。
